digest.component_or_area: LLM completion verification and recovery orchestration
propositions: completion.py and completion_recovery.py each exceed or touch the 800 LOC module-size CI cap, blocking any new edits until refactored

completion.py contains four distinct concerns (operation orchestration, child-closure gate, epic-bug screen, verdict reconciliation) that must be separated into dedicated modules with clear contractual boundaries
completion_recovery.py contains three distinct concerns (criteria surface/admission bounds, failure taxonomy, recovery orchestration) that must be separated into dedicated modules

The refactoring must preserve all documented public API seams via re-exports so existing callers (gate_ops.py, epic_bug_screen.py, tests) remain unchanged except for import paths and monkeypatch targets
All moved symbols must be verifiable as patchable at their runtime call sites by string-sweep grepping across src and tests to detect orphaned patch targets
